## Review checklist

- [ ] The branch contains one reviewable concern and no unrelated files.
- [ ] Commits are coherent, and tests accompany behavior changes.
- [ ] Numerical assumptions, parameterization, and provenance are explicit.
- [ ] Formatting, linting, strict typing, tests, and coverage pass.
- [ ] Wheel and source archive build and pass installed smoke tests.
- [ ] Documentation and examples match the implemented public API.
- [ ] No secrets, local environments, build output, or exploratory data are committed.
